title: Destroyer of Worlds
author: Ortticus
desc:
This is a 5-day hypertrophy-focused bro hybrid split built around the latest 2026 ACSM resistance-training research.

The mission is simple: BUILD MASS.


Bowling-ball shoulders
Cliff-like upper chest
Bat-wing lats and a massive V-taper Thick rhomboids and dense mid-back
Gorilla arms and forearms
Tree-trunk quads, hamstrings and calves
